subject: 关于林彻同志离职的通知
body:
各位同事：

兹通知，档案调查员林彻（工号 LCHE）已于 2026-07-15 提交离职申请，即日起不再担任本机构职务。

请各部门配合办理交接手续。

档案管理系统
note: CRITICAL: email was sent on July 12 (Shanghai time 11:42), but claims resignation was submitted on July 15. This is impossible unless the email was backdated to create a false timeline.
